updates.closure_rationale: Actual independently allocated string owners distinguish empty control from owned empty content and preserve previous allocation/content on failure. Byte-content and explicitly bounded ASCII-canonical equality/hash consistently exclude cache/address/padding. The canonical relation and fixed unsigned64 FNV framing are derived separately from representation equality; equality implies equal hash without collision-free or authentication claims. Separate finite key and string triples exercise reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity. Inspected C11-draft unsigned arithmetic and Rust Hash/Eq/prefix/portability passages support explicit enforcement bounds. Actual Rust2021 derived cache-inclusive equality differs from custom canonical equality/hash; no fixed Rust hash value is assumed. Strictly decreasing trace measure proves termination and local-move minimality, with an executed nonmonotone callback exposing a smaller disconnected witness. Six profiles pass4anchors and8compiled ordinary controls, including actual retained MOD13/14;4compiling stubs refuse. Independent immutable-list/byte oracle matches24238cases:1614hashes,22400replays and224reductions, including3948admittedreplays and240failurewitnesses. The actual original fault_adapter implements the inspected testing.faults contract; retained PR-T32-02 declares no C ABI, so no nonexistent source import is claimed. Required changed owner/operation-trace support uses real allocation, deterministic failure ordinals, full reference-model precondition admission and first-divergence classes. Reduction preserves the exact class and rejects invalid or different-callback-error candidates; unexpected host failure aborts unchanged. GCC/Clang O0/O3 actual malloc-wrapper experiments execute initial/candidate refusals with zero retained owners and positive reduction. ASCII normalization is explicitly bounded, not Unicode NFC/case folding. All13cost dimensions and seven equal-contract samples are present; unaided delayed assessment remains external. Bounded author support only.
